svg.text: ROCm 7.14 · Three-agent compaction chain at a 100k target
What / how to read: Measure context growth, prefix reuse, latency and stall behaviour under repeated compaction. The prompt-compute counter peaks near 65k tokens/s because it
credits work in bursts at request completion; that is not true PP. Read this as a compaction workload, not a clean throughput baseline.
PP unavailable: completion-credited counter bursts are diagnostic only, not sustained prefill throughput.
